voci.titolo: Malaysia Set to Hold Rates on Strong Growth, Signal Hike in 2027
voci.riassunto: Malaysia’s central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged at its final policy meeting of the year on Thursday while signaling scope for a hike early in 2027 as economic growth remains strong.

voci.titolo: The economy brought Trump back to power. Now it's his downfall
voci.riassunto: Participants in the CNBC Voter Poll ranked the economy the most important issue facing the country, ahead of topics tied to democracy and immigration.

voci.titolo: Analysis: The Democrats have one chance to extract concessions from Trump. Markets will hate it
voci.riassunto: The next debt-ceiling confrontation could reverse Washington's traditional political roles, raising the possibility of spending concessions, market volatility and a damaging default.

voci.titolo: Private companies added 86,000 jobs in October, slightly higher than expected, ADP says
voci.riassunto: Private-sector job growth held steady in October, with gains spread across sectors

voci.titolo: Euro zone inflation hits 4% for first time in three years as interest rate hike looms
voci.riassunto: It was driven by energy inflation, which surged above 20% in October.

voci.titolo: Dollar Falls Most in Two Months as Traders Weigh Gridlock Risks
voci.riassunto: The dollar sank the most in two months as Democrats’ sweeping victory in the midterm elections fueled concern about potential political gridlock and raised the prospect of diminished spending on AI by US tech giants.

voci.titolo: Stocks, Bonds Climb After US Election as Oil Sinks: Markets Wrap
voci.riassunto: A Democratic sweep of Congress that highlighted opposition of the Iran war extended this week’s plunge in oil prices, helping drive stocks and bonds to big post-election gains.

voci.titolo: Job openings posted big September gain in positive sign for labor market ahead of payrolls report
voci.riassunto: The BLS reported job openings at 7.52 million, up 333,000 from August and well above the Dow Jones consensus outlook for 7.15 million

voci.titolo: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
voci.riassunto: The Reserve Bank of Australia's decision was in line with expectations from economists polled by Reuters, and marked its fifth rate increase this year.

voci.titolo: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
voci.riassunto: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

voci.titolo: Euro zone economy slows to 0.4% growth in Q3 as crisis-hit France contracts
voci.riassunto: The euro zone showed surprising resilience, but weak productivity, industrial competitiveness challenges and demographic pressures remain, analysts said.

voci.titolo: Third-quarter U.S. GDP increases a better-than-expected 3.4% as September inflation accelerates
voci.riassunto: The personal consumption expenditures price index was projected to increase 0.5% in September for an annual rate of 3.7%, according to the Dow Jones consensus.

voci.titolo: Analysis: Kevin Warsh is keeping Wall Street guessing. It may be his most powerful tool
voci.riassunto: The new chairman made clear he leans toward higher interest rates, but left himself options depending on how the data comes in.

voci.titolo: The politics of President Lagarde's European Central Bank early exit — and who could replace her
voci.riassunto: European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde will step down on Feb. 7 next year, she announced Thursday.

voci.titolo: European Central Bank keeps key interest rate on hold at 2.5%
voci.riassunto: Markets saw the decision as a hawkish pause and were last pricing in a 67% chance of a December rate hike.

voci.titolo: Here are five key takeaways from the Fed rate decision and Warsh news conference
voci.riassunto: Even though the interest-rate vote went as expected, there were a few surprises out of this week's Federal Open Market Committee meeting.

voci.titolo: Bessent says 'not necessarily' a mistake if the Fed hikes again
voci.riassunto: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent joined CNBC for an interview on Oct. 28, 2026.

voci.titolo: The UK cuts energy bills, taxes banks and boosts defense in high-stakes budget
voci.riassunto: The U.K. budget cuts household energy costs, raises taxes on banks and directs billions toward defense, Ukraine and artificial intelligence
